root_cause_criterion.description: Before the first bag contentType is dispatched with strcmp in gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag, the local buffer oid must be zero-initialized so any bytes not written by asn1_read_value remain defined.

nodes.description: At the contentType dispatch sink, strcmp compares sizeof(DATA_OID) bytes against oid while len records that asn1_read_value wrote a shorter prefix for the witness bag OID.

edges.description: The declaration-sized oid buffer reaches asn1_read_value with more capacity than len bytes written, so unread tail state would persist unless the buffer was initialized first.
The same oid buffer populated by asn1_read_value is passed unchanged to the strcmp dispatch sink.
